scientific_integrity: The volume-normalized surface and second intrinsic volume are proved by an explicit Euclidean facet/ridge partition. No external independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: All antichain layers must have cardinality at least two; canonical coordinate Euclidean metric only; higher-order Steiner coefficients not determined; historical priority subject to broader literature. Finite tests corroborate rather than establish all-dimensional identities.
title: First two Steiner coefficients of layered order polytopes forget layer sizes
